Specification: A PlusCal-derived specification of the EWD998 termination detection algorithm using a bag-based network model. It simulates the asynchronous exchange of messages and token movement across a ring of nodes, verifying that the initiator correctly identifies system-wide termination while accounting for in-flight messages and node status transitions.
